# Trustpages

> Trustpages is an independent web design, web development, and digital growth studio based in Bikapur, Ayodhya district, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded by Shivansh Tripathi, Trustpages builds high-performance custom websites with Next.js and React that load in under 1.5 seconds, rank #1 on Google search and Google Maps, and get cited by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) through structured SEO, AEO, and GEO.
